# LittleTube

> LittleTube is an ultra-lightweight video player for phones and low-spec Android TV boxes. It is distributed by sideloading from this site, not through Google Play. The app resolves and plays videos client-side and can download videos to the public media library (Movies / Music). Use the downloader only for content you have the rights to (your own uploads, Creative Commons, public domain).

## Download

- [LittleTube — Download](https://littletube.vercel.app/): Download page with install instructions for Android TV / Smart LED (TV browser, USB stick, or ADB), Android mobile, and the latest version info. The Download APK button is wired to the update manifest below.

## Update manifest

- [update.json](https://littletube.vercel.app/update.json): JSON manifest the LittleTube app checks for updates. Fields: versionCode, versionName, apkUrl, sha256, releaseNotes. The app downloads a newer APK only when the manifest versionCode is higher than the installed build, and installs it only when the APK's SHA-256 matches the manifest.

## TV pages

- [How to Run YouTube on LED TV](https://littletube.vercel.app/how-to-run-youtube-on-led-tv.html): Four ways to run YouTube on any LED TV — the official YouTube app on smart TVs, casting from a phone, a Fire TV Stick or Android box for non-smart TVs, and the LittleTube sideload for downloads and low-spec TVs — with FAQs.
- [LED TV Mein YouTube Kaisy Chalain (Roman Urdu)](https://littletube.vercel.app/led-tv-mein-youtube-kaisy-chalain.html): Roman Urdu version of the YouTube-on-LED-TV guide — the same 4 methods with FAQs.
- [Video Downloader for Android TV](https://littletube.vercel.app/android-tv-video-downloader.html): LittleTube for Android TV, Google TV and TV boxes — D-pad remote control, no ads, direct gallery downloads, built for low-RAM TVs.
- [Video Downloader for Fire TV Stick](https://littletube.vercel.app/fire-tv-stick.html): Install LittleTube on a Fire TV Stick with the Downloader app (no USB needed) or ADB.
- [VidMate for Android TV](https://littletube.vercel.app/vidmate-for-android-tv.html): Honest comparison — VidMate is made for phones, not TV remotes; LittleTube is the TV-first alternative.

## Source code

- [LittleTube app source](https://github.com/waseemchuhan676-spec/litetube): Android app source code (Kotlin, AndroidX Media3, NewPipeExtractor). Includes the in-app updater, Gallery downloader, and TV D-pad navigation.
- [LittleTube releases](https://github.com/waseemchuhan676-spec/litetube/releases): Published APK releases with SHA-256 hashes.
- [This site's source](https://github.com/waseemchuhan676-spec/litetube-updater): Source of this landing page, the update manifest, and the Vercel configuration.
